name: Alisa Erolis
source:
A girl who works as a waitress at the local bar, "Haniwa Roman."
She is in love with the bartender, [url=/c148090]Ijuuin[/url], and is working hard to save up money for their wedding.
She uses unique words such as "hanyarin♪ (greetings)" and "yorori~ (nice to meet you)," and treats customers in a casual manner.
